deadline.quote: PhD applications: December 15, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time (UTC-5)

app_fee.value: The department's PhD fee is USD 25; waivers can be requested in the PhD application.
app_fee.quote: WILL THE DEPARTMENT WAIVE THE US $25 APPLICATION FEE?

gre_general.value: GRE is not required and is not considered in review.
gre_general.quote: GREs are not required for any applications and will not be considered as part of the application review process.

english_waiver.value: Whiting School of Engineering sets the English-test waiver rule and the page listing it could not be fetched, so the Krieger rule is not shown for Mechanical Engineering.

funding.value: PhD students are fully funded for the duration of the PhD; the 2026-27 stipend is USD 52,000.
funding.quote: Ph.D. students are fully funded – tuition, health insurance, stipend, and a one-time matriculation fee – for the duration of their Ph.D. program while they are in a full-time, resident status.

entry_route.value: Apply directly to the PhD with or without a master's.
entry_route.quote: Applicants who want to earn a PhD, whether or not they have a master’s degree, are encouraged to apply directly to the PhD program.

supervisor.value: The page does not give an answer on choosing an advisor before applying.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Department says it follows the university preference of TOEFL 100 or IELTS 7.0.
